**Order Date:** June 16, 2025

**DECISION: APPROVED**

Your prior authorization request for laparoscopic sleeve gastrectomy (CPT 43775) has been approved.

**Criteria Met:**

**BMI Requirement:** Met. Most recent BMI on 5/20/2025 is 44.7 kg/m², exceeding the required threshold of 35 or greater.

**Co-morbidity Requirement:** Met. Patient has documented obesity-related co-morbidities: essential hypertension (active since 6/23/2021) and osteoarthritis of knee (active since 2/8/2024).

**Prior Weight Management:** Met. Medical record documents completion of a 6-month physician-supervised weight management program including dietitian visits and phentermine trial. Net weight loss of 2 kg was regained after discontinuation, documented as unsuccessful by treating physician.

**Covered Procedure:** Met. Laparoscopic sleeve gastrectomy is a covered procedure type.

This authorization is valid for [authorization period]. Please contact us if you have questions.
